schema:
CREATE TABLE branches (branch_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, district_code TEXT NULL, sub_code TEXT NULL, region TEXT NOT NULL, manager_name TEXT NULL, is_franchised INTEGER NULL);
CREATE TABLE metrics (branch_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, total_orders REAL NULL, returned_orders REAL NULL, FOREIGN KEY (branch_id) REFERENCES branches (branch_id));
correct_query: SELECT COUNT(T2.manager_name) FROM metrics AS T1 INNER JOIN branches AS T2 ON T1.branch_id = T2.branch_id WHERE T2.region = 'West' AND T2.is_franchised = 0 AND CAST(T1.returned_orders AS REAL) * 100 / T1.total_orders < 0.25
